scripts.compile:cli: npm run compile:lang && cargo build --locked --release --features embed-languages --bin uffda
scripts.test: npm run compile:lang && cargo xtask test && npm run test:tools
scripts.test:tools: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/compile-lang.test.ts scripts/line-endings.test.ts scripts/package-rust-cli.test.ts scripts/verify-rust-codec.test.ts .github/actions/uffda-setup/resolve_release.test.ts test/perf/data-codec.report.test.ts
scripts.fmt:uff: npm run compile:lang && npm run cli -- fmt "src/lang/**/*.uff" "examples/**/*.uff"
scripts.pre: npm run format:check && npm run fmt:uff && npm run lint && npm run check:types && cargo xtask check && npm run test:tools && npx jsr publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
